title: I just released my first Android game, Aether Run, built with the help of ChatGPT and Codex!
author: Miserable_Wash_8301
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
I recently released my first game, Aether Run, on Google Play!  
It's a snowy endless runner where you're chased by a giant snowball or an angry Santa while dodging obstacles and hungry polar bears. There are Day and Night modes, a global leaderboard, and a separate Zen mode where you can relax under the northern lights.  
I developed it using React, TypeScript and Three.js, with ChatGPT and Codex playing a significant role throughout development. I mainly used ChatGPT for planning, discussing features, debugging approaches and reviewing changes, while Codex helped with implementation, testing and fixing issues.  
One of the biggest challenges was getting everything working reliably on Android, especially rewarded ads, the native WebView integration and performance on older devices(this still needs improvement). AI helped a lot with development, but actual device testing and polishing the gameplay still required plenty of iteration.  
It's been a really interesting experience seeing how far AI-assisted game development can go, especially as a solo developer. There's still a lot I want to improve, and more updates are coming!  
I'd love to hear how others here are using AI coding agents for game development, especially when it comes to testing and polishing games for release.

Google Play Store Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mistrailgames.aetherrun  
Other devices: https://aether-run-two.vercel.app/
